diff --git a/debian/control b/debian/control
index bbc783b..0c46b78 100644
--- a/debian/control
+++ b/debian/control
@@ -13,7 +13,7 @@ Build-Depends: debhelper-compat (= 14),
                libsystemd-dev,

-               pandoc,

diff --git a/debian/rules b/debian/rules
index f8169ba..ac50faf 100755
--- a/debian/rules
+++ b/debian/rules
@@ -10,6 +10,13 @@ endif
 
 NON_COHERENT_DMA_ARCHS = alpha arc armel armhf hppa m68k sh4
 
+# pandoc is not available on i386 in Ubuntu and the GitHub tag tarball ships
+# no prebuilt man pages, so do not build/install man pages there.
+NO_MAN_PAGES_ARCHS = i386
+ifneq (,$(filter $(DEB_HOST_ARCH),$(NO_MAN_PAGES_ARCHS)))
+EXTRA_CMAKE_FLAGS += -DNO_MAN_PAGES=1
+endif
+
 dh_params = --with python3 --builddirectory=build-deb
 
 %:
@@ -17,8 +24,8 @@ dh_params = --with python3 --builddirectory=build-deb
 
 override_dh_auto_clean:
 	dh_auto_clean
-	for package in ibverbs-providers libibverbs-dev rdma-core; do \
-		test ! -e debian/$$package.install.backup || mv debian/$$package.install.backup debian/$$package.install; \
+	for backup in debian/*.install.backup; do \
+		test ! -e $$backup || mv $$backup $${backup%.backup}; \
 	done
 
 # Upstream wishes to use CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release, and ensures that has a
@@ -63,6 +70,12 @@ ifeq (,$(filter-out $(NON_COHERENT_DMA_ARCHS),$(DEB_HOST_ARCH)))
 	done
 	sed -i '/efa\|hns\|ionic\|mana\|mlx[45]/d' debian/ibverbs-providers.install debian/libibverbs-dev.install debian/rdma-core.install
 endif
+ifneq (,$(filter $(DEB_HOST_ARCH),$(NO_MAN_PAGES_ARCHS)))
+	for install in debian/*.install; do \
+		test -e $$install.backup || cp $$install $$install.backup; \
+	done
+	sed -i '/usr\/share\/man/d' debian/*.install
+endif
 	dh_auto_install
